optimization.method: independent OMPL RRTConnect seeds; normalized broad-route style selection
optimization.soft_clearance_method: distal FCL padding probes in 5 mm bands; NOT a hard-clearance certificate
optimization.duration_role: at most 2x fastest valid duration (and <=120s); tie-break only within budget

variants.details: Trajectory would be impractically slow; rejected instead of creeping

optimization.collision_check_order: fastest valid reference, then ascending style score; every winner densely validated

model.joint_coordinates: encoder_to_joint; corrections embedded in joint origins
model.joint_limits_coordinate_rule: q_model = q_saved + offset; saved limits = original model limits - offset
model.warning: STL bore assembly is checked mathematically. Mount plane/yaw and left stick require physical verification. Mesh mounting is provisional, not a certified physical model.

physical_execution_blockers: Saved plans never authorize motion; explicit live --execute and commissioning are required
Actual resting and static left-arm states must be measured with power available
Verify depth alignment and CAD mounting plane/yaw; left stick geometry remains unverified
Verify supported resting pose; detected table/other collisions are not exempted
Fresh static-scene recheck, bounded tracking, supervised area and supported-rest verification required before torque control
environment_assumption: Unobserved space does not block planning. Obstacles absent from the captured depth map are not accounted for.
perception_assumption: Initial stick surface/voxel uncertainty and depth occluded by its nominal camera silhouette are excluded from the obstacle cloud. These regions are unobserved, NOT proven free. Model alignment and physical stick clearance must be verified before motor execution.

current_state_check.note: Valid at acquisition/check time only, not ongoing feedback or motion authorization
